root_cause_tested: Whether continuation from the v5 path-copy checkpoint can copy the live COUNT observation into WRITE while exact target count 470 remains held out.

training_run.curriculum: Continuation from v5 with WRITE turns oversampled three-to-one so the model must copy live observations into demo-out.txt.
training_run.heldout_policy: Exact target count 470 is excluded; nearby 400-499 counts except 470 are oversampled for observation-copy training.
training_run.supervision_policy: Only action tokens are trained; first action must copy the path and extension from the goal, later actions copy live observations.
